plan.title: test(session): session-start tests read Claude host env vars, so task check fails under Claude Code

narratives.Description: test(session): session-start tests read Claude host env vars, so task check fails under Claude Code
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

When `task check` runs inside a Claude Code agent shell, Claude host environment variables (`CLAUDECODE`, `CLAUDE_*`) leak into the session-start test suites. Those tests then take the Claude-host branches of host and session detection, and fail. The product code is fine; the tests are not isolated from the host environment that runs them.

## Evidence

On 2026-11-13 (Directive 0.129.8), a worker ran `task check` from a Claude Code sub-agent in a linked worktree for #6271. The `ts:check-lane` step failed with 44 tests:

- 32 failures were in session-start tests and disappeared when the same suite was re-run with the `CLAUDE*` variables removed from the environment (the session-start tests then passed 47/47).
- The remaining 12 were unrelated environment issues (SCM not ready in a linked worktree, a Git Bash `tar` path, one spawn-heavy test).

Telling the 32 host-env failures apart from real ones cost about 15 minutes. It also makes an agent-run `task check` red for reasons unrelated to the change being tested.

## Expected

Session-start and host-detection tests build their environment explicitly. They pass an empty or test-specific env bag, and never inherit `process.env` host markers. Tests that exercise the Claude-host path set the markers themselves. This is a test-isolation fix only: no new check, gate or refusal.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Given `CLAUDECODE=1` and other `CLAUDE_*` variables set in the shell, when the session-start test files run, then they pass with the same results as in a clean shell.
- [ ] Tests that need Claude-host detection set those variables inside the test, not from the ambient environment.
- [ ] No production code path changes behaviour.

Related: #5943 (Windows test-lane failures), #3134 (Claude Code host detection signals).

issueCommentThread.body:
## Recurrence: `session-start-rearm.test.ts` (2026-11-16)

A worker hit this again on 2026-11-16 and had to run its brief's verify command with `CLAUDE*` unset. Reproduced on `origin/master` at `3e26af7c7`.

**Failing tests** (`packages/core/src/session/session-start-rearm.test.ts`, suite `session re-arm vs cold ceremony tiers (#2992)`):

- `re-arm refuses when ritual state is missing (cold required)`: line 508, `expected undefined to be false` (`rearm_eligible`)
- `compact marks rearm_needed and denial prefers re-arm recovery`: line 850, deny message lacks `session:start --rearm`; it says occupancy "refuses to mint an owner on host claude" and suggests `--session-id=host:claude:v1:...` built from the ambient session id
- `cold path still records ceremony_tier cold`: line 909, `expected 1 to be +0` (`result.code`)

**Runs** (`npx vitest run packages/core/src/session/session-start-rearm.test.ts`, Windows, Git Bash):

| Environment | Result |
|---|---|
| Inside a Claude Code session (`CLAUDE*` set) | 3 failed, 22 passed |
| All `CLAUDE*` unset | 25 passed |
| Only `CLAUDECODE`, `CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` unset | 25 passed |

**Leak traced:** `resolveOccupancySessionId` in `packages/core/src/session/occupancy.ts` (line 1772) uses `input.env ?? process.env`, and the deny-message path (line 1448) uses `env ?? process.env`. `detectDeclaredIdentityHosts` (`host-session-owner.ts`) then sees the claude presence markers (`CLAUDECODE`, `CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`) and refuses the mint. The test cases pass `env: {}` to the command but do not reach this env input.

**Fix pattern already in tree:** `packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.test.ts` (#6227) clears `/^(CLAUDE|CURSOR_|GROK_|DEFT_|OPENCLAW|WARP_)/` from `process.env` in `beforeAll` and restores it in `afterAll`. Applying the same isolation to `session-start-rearm.test.ts` should close this file.

**Acceptance (this file):**
- Given `CLAUDE*` variables set in the environment, when `session-start-rearm.test.ts` runs, then all 25 tests pass.
- The file isolates host env the same way `hooks/dispatcher.test.ts` does.
